test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing towards a man in photo, Ram said. "He is the brother of my son's paternal grandfather". How man is related to Ram?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given statement: Pointing towards a man in photo, Ram said. "He is the brother of my son's paternal grandfather".

As Ram's gender is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1) If Ram is male.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05533d3476322c17644376272c372a04a425614bd50eaef6f35d9f18ef6d02fd.png] 

Case 2) If Ram is female.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/310bf0fabd7bbdff6243a4f8efed40acf465e0a2f6f8f33b1ddf32aa3113059c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56d03c772155eaf03180a664ed5c97d05e3104f6d5cd6c4b8040779a7fb0b9ae.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05533d3476322c17644376272c372a04a425614bd50eaef6f35d9f18ef6d02fd.png] 

So, the man can be Ram's either paternal uncle i.e. father's brother or husband's paternal uncle.

As out of all the options 'Father's brother' is given, therefore case is eliminated.

Thus, the man is Ram's father's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
